name: Moran the Destroyer
description: A giant who fought Odum and Broadbark for a hundred dawns, then fell into namesleep and awoke as Moran the Gardener.

description_citations.text: Morningtide: card flavor text (Morningtide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Odum and Broadbark fight the giant Moran the Destroyer for a hundred dawns until he falls into namesleep and awakens as Moran the Gardener.
timeline.quote: Their battle lasted a hundred dawns, until Moran became so exhausted that he fell into namesleep.

citation.text: Indomitable Ancients (Morningtide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: Odum and Broadbark were the only beings mighty enough to challenge the giant Moran the Destroyer.
